[1/2] delegate never runs through cmd.exe, ends options before the brief, and checks the model name without its #variant (ADR-194); [2/2] ADR-195 records the push 21-30 review

impact_assessment.why: Pushes 21-30 review: on Windows opencode is an npm .CMD shim, so a brief with a quote and & ran arbitrary commands and %VAR% expanded into the brief; a brief starting with -- was parsed as opencode flags (--auto approves permissions); opencode/<paid>#-free passed the free-model check.
impact_assessment.benefits: No shell interprets a brief; the brief is always the message; only free models run.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a .cmd/.bat opencode whose real executable cannot be found refuses briefs holding cmd metacharacters; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests with a fake shim and a recorded argv; Phase 4 and verify_commit per milestone.
